columns.name: z
columns.meaning: map-frame height; vertical datum is unspecified

columns.name: lanelet_id
columns.meaning: Required positive Lanelet2 lanelet relation ID in kcity_lanelet2.osm; global routing uses this ID directly in its OSM-defined direction.

format.row_order: Route traversal order; zero-based row index is the implicit checkpoint index.
format.record_rule: Each data row contains one checkpoint with exactly five fields. lanelet_id references an existing lanelet in kcity_lanelet2.osm; multiple checkpoints may reference the same lanelet. Rows do not contain a separate checkpoint ID field.

coordinate_system.coordinates: Local offsets from the map origin in UTM zone 52N.

high_speed_section.meaning: 고속주행구간: 경로 진행 순서에서 체크포인트 10부터 13까지의 구간.

heading.conversion_to_ros: Convert degrees to radians before creating a yaw quaternion.
